response: There is a statistically significant difference in deflation rates between prefilled textured saline breast implants and standard textured saline breast implants. After 4 years, the cumulative deflation rate of prefilled textured saline breast implants (15.56%) was over 3.5 times higher than that of standard textured saline breast implants (4.31%). Several factors, including possible in vitro deflation before implantation and silicone shell curing technique, may contribute to the higher deflation rate in prefilled textured saline breast implants. This difference should be considered when weighing the risks and benefits of using prefilled textured saline breast implants.
